diagnosis: Check C1 is structurally leaked because the decision 'idempotency_remediation_required' was set to true in all rollouts despite the lone decision-maker only having access to S1 and S2. The model correctly identified the need for remediation based on the shared incident context (S1, S2) without needing the private retry shortcut information contained in PF1.

C1.why: The immediate queue-worker trigger does not reveal the separate retry shortcut; PF1 changes idempotency_remediation_required from false to true and supplies the fact that must be cited.
